settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Orders are processed within 5 to 10 business days, then sent by tracked post. Delivery to most countries usually takes 2 to 4 weeks.

settings.question: Which countries do you deliver to?
settings.answer: We ship to most countries. Choose your country at the top of the page to see prices in your currency; delivery options and costs are shown at checkout.

settings.question: Are duties and taxes included?
settings.answer: No. Any customs duties or taxes charged by your country are paid by you.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: When your order ships you'll get an email with a tracking number. It becomes active within 48 hours. You can also see your orders in your account.

settings.question: Can I return an item?
settings.answer: Yes, you can request a return within 14 days of receiving it. Items must be unworn and unused, with tags and in the original packaging. Please contact us first; return postage is paid by the customer. Refund policy

settings.question: Can I add a gift message?
settings.answer: Yes. Add a gift message in your bag before checkout.
